scope: G16 persisted-run scoring preflight; G17-G20 paused
change: A cited source read now counts as model-visible only when the parsed tool message equals the persisted source-call output as stable JSON. A matching callId and excerpt alone no longer suffice.
negativeControl: A model input tool message retained the same persisted callId and cited excerpt but added an unrecorded claim; persisted-run binding rejected its citation.
limitations: This validates saved database and model-input records; it does not prove that provider-side execution received those bytes without an admitted real run and provider evidence.
The dedicated evaluation runner, source independence, Gold freeze, paid admission and real dual-arm review remain open.
